derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding, all classes (556,239 ÷ 635,812,750)

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: As of September 1, 2026, there were 635,812,750 shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding, consisting of 315,433,188 outstanding shares of Class C Common Stock, 276,744,341 outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock, and 43,635,221 outstanding shares of Class B Common Stock.

inputs.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 14 Capitalization, share class rights
inputs.quote: The Class A Common Stock, the Class B Common Stock, the Class C Common Stock, and the Class D Common Stock share equally in dividends declared or accumulated and have equal participation rights in undistributed earnings.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of March 9, 2026, there were 3,516 holders of record of our Class C Common Stock, six holders of record of our Class A Common Stock, and five holders of record of our Class B Common Stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds the listed Class C; the denominator is all classes (A, B and C) from the Q2 FY2027 10-Q cover at September 1, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: listed Class C only; the 10-K also gives six holders of record of Class A and five of Class B.
